Hi Jasmine,

We're preparing our vendor CAIQ for an internal review next month and need to collect the control mappings and evidence from Redwood for a subset of controls (CCM 3.1, focusing on Data Protection, Identity, and Cryptographic Key Management). Can you confirm who on your side owns the following artifacts so we can schedule evidence collection?

- KMS rotation policy and proof of recent rotation
- Runtime telemetry access logs (last 90 days)
- Tenant isolation assertion and separation diagrams

Target deadline for our internal reviewers is June 9 — would you be able to provide an intake plan and expected delivery window? We can accept evidence via a shared Drive folder (see link below) or via your portal/upload.

Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-caiq-evidence

Thanks — if you want to loop product/security owners, please do.

—Martin
